en.title: Accessibility statement
en.meta: Accessibility statement for dub.m365.fm: our goal (WCAG 2.2 AA), what we have done, known limitations and how to report barriers.
en.intro: M365.FM (Mirko Peters) wants everyone to be able to use this website. Our goal is to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA.
en.status_p: This website is partially accessible. In October 2026 we checked the main page types (home page, language pages, episode pages, profile page, community page, recommended list) with automated tests (axe-core, light and dark mode) and fixed the issues found. Automated tests cannot find every barrier; a full manual test with screen readers is still pending.
en.d1: Sufficient colour contrast in light and dark mode
en.d2: Clear page structure with headings, landmarks and a “skip to content” link
en.d3: Keyboard operation for menus, language switch, checklists, comments and settings
en.d4: Text alternatives for images and flags; the language of every page is declared
en.d5: Accessibility settings on every page (text size, high contrast, dark mode, easy-to-read font, text spacing, underlined links, reduced motion)
en.d6: Transcripts for the episodes and a text version of each article
en.l1: Articles, summaries and audio versions in other languages are produced with the help of AI (dubbing and machine translation). They can contain errors or be hard to understand in places.
en.l2: Embedded third-party content (YouTube videos, Spreaker player) is not under our control; their accessibility depends on the providers.
en.l3: Some infographics are interactive; the same information is always available as plain text in the list or table next to them.
en.l4: Translations of the interface into some languages have not yet been reviewed by native speakers.
en.contact_p: If you find a barrier or need content in a different format, please email {MAIL}. Describe the page and the problem; we will answer as soon as possible and fix what we can.
